scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res/
scripts.build:debug: npm run bundle:android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.jdk ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk PATH=$HOME/.jdk/bin:$PATH ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cd android && JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.jdk ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk PATH=$HOME/.jdk/bin:$PATH ./gradlew assembleRelease
